en.title: Marvel's Wolverine PS5 Controller: Grab Yours Before It's Gone
en.summary: A fierce, limited-edition DualSense controller themed around Insomniac's upcoming Marvel's Wolverine game is still available for preorder. This battle-worn design is a must-have for fans, but stock is dwindling.
en.body:
The gaming world is abuzz with anticipation for **Marvel's Wolverine**, Insomniac Games' next big PlayStation 5 exclusive following their critically acclaimed **Spider-Man** series. While we eagerly await more details on the gameplay and story, Sony has already unveiled a striking piece of hardware to accompany the release: a limited-edition **Marvel's Wolverine DualSense Wireless Controller**. This isn't just any controller; it's a statement piece designed to evoke the savage spirit of Logan himself.

The most sought-after variant, the "Battle Yellow" edition, features a design that looks like it's been through a brawl. Jagged, vibrant yellow claw marks slash across the black touchpad and faceplate, hinting at the game's promised bloody action. The yellow theme extends to the controller's base, the iconic PlayStation button shapes, and even the D-pad arrows. Adding to the gritty aesthetic, subtle gray scuff marks adorn the grips, completing the battle-damaged look. It's a bold aesthetic that stands out in the growing collection of unique PS5 controller designs.

## A Collector's Item for Fans

For dedicated fans of **Marvel's Wolverine** and Insomniac's work, this controller is more than just a peripheral; it's a tangible connection to one of the most anticipated games of the year. The "Battle Yellow" design, with its aggressive claw marks and worn finish, perfectly captures the essence of the iconic anti-hero. Beyond the striking visuals, the controller offers the standard, advanced haptic feedback and adaptive triggers that make the DualSense a premium experience. This blend of unique design and familiar functionality makes it a compelling collectible. While preorders have already sold out at some retailers, the "Battle Yellow" version remains available at select stores, though its limited nature means it's unlikely to stay in stock for long. A second, "Adamantium" white variant offers a similar design with a metallic white finish, providing a slightly more subdued, yet equally stylish, option for those who prefer a less flashy look.

## Preorder Now or Regret It Later

The **Marvel's Wolverine** Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Wireless Controller is slated for release on September 15, coinciding with the game's launch. Priced at $89.99, this controller is a premium accessory for a premium experience. Given the rapid sell-outs of similar limited-edition hardware in the past, especially for major PlayStation exclusives, interested players are advised to secure their preorder as soon as possible. Checking multiple retailers like Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, GameStop, and PlayStation Direct is recommended, as availability can fluctuate. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of the **Marvel's Wolverine** hype before it disappears.

content_raw: The big PS5 exclusive this fall is Marvel’s Wolverine. It’s Insomniac Studios’ follow-up to the excellent (and massively successful) Spider-Man games, and it promises to be a bloody good time . To go along with the game, Sony is releasing a series of limited-edition Marvel’s Wolverine-themed PS5 hardware . Among IGN readers, by far the most popular item has been the Battle Yellow DualSense Wireless Controller. And while preorders have sold out at some retailers, it’s still available at most of them ( see it at Amazon ). It costs $89.99 and is set to release on September 15, the same day as the game. Marvel’s Wolverine Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controller Get it at Amazon Get it at Walmart Get it at Best Buy Get it at GameStop Get it at PS Direct Get it at Smyths Toys UK Get it at Target - SOLD OUT Functionally, Marvel’s Wolverine Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Wireless Controller is a standard PS5 controller. What makes it stand out is the design, which makes it look like Wolverine got mad while playing Fortnite and attacked the thing. It features three jagged claw marks across the face of the controller. The marks are vibrant yellow, set against the black of the grips and touchpad. It looks fierce. The bottom of the controller is also yellow, as are the shapes on the face buttons and the tiny arrows on the D-pad. On the left and right grips you’ll also find gray scuff marks that add to the battle-damage effect. Overall, it’s one of the coolest PS5 controller designs yet — and there have been a lot . The controller actually comes in two variations. There’s a “Battle Yellow” one that’s bright and bold. Then there’s an “Adamantium” white one that features the same scuffed-and-clawed design, but with metallic white to accent the black, making it somewhat less flashy. The Adamantium white one was a PlayStation Direct exclusive, and it has, unfortunately, sold out. Both designs also have matching console covers you can buy separately, though some of those have sold out as well (the Battle Yellow PS5 slim console cover is still in stock at PS Direct ). It’s possible PS Direct will get more in stock before launch, but I wouldn’t hold my breath. If you want any of these items, you’d be wise to make your purchase sooner than later. For more, check out our Marvel's Wolverine preorder guide to get the rundown on what preorder bonuses you can expect if you lock in a copy of the game early. Chris Reed is a senior commerce editor and deals expert for IGN. He also runs IGN's board game and LEGO coverage. You can follow him on Bluesky .
